svg.text: All the red coefficients [k, v] are set by the population level
(e.g., GenTime, Iteroparity; posterior draws from Stage 1)

text.tspan: X ∈ { γ, βintra, βgrass, βshrub, βforb, βclimate }

svg.text: Size [i, t] & Local environment [q, t] (z & E)
Σx θx[v] × z[i, t] × Wx[i, t]
Σx ωx[v] × E[q, t] × Wx[i, t]
Crowding by same species & other species [i, t] (Wx)
Wx[i, t] = Σn ∈ x Fmain(dn) × An
intra: same species (its own size measure)
grass, shrub: other species (basal, canopy area); forb: counts
Linear predictor for individual i, population k, quadrat q, year t, vital rate v
η[i, t, v] = ηind[i, t, v] + ηplot[q, v] + ηcrowd[i, t, v] + ηclim[i, t, v] + ηyear[i, t, v]
NegBin( C′ × exp ηR[k, q, t] + exp b[k] , r[k] )
C′ = p[k] × quadrat cover + (1 − p[k]) × group mean cover; ηR uses √cover in place of z and W; b[k]: background recruitment
Forb submodel (point-mapped species pooled as forb; fitted separately)
α0,f[v] + γf[v] × E[q, t] + Σx βx,f[v] × Wx[i, t] + βclimate,f[v] × climate[t]
Σx δx,f[v] × climate[t] × Wx[i, t] + εt,f[v] + εg,f[v] + εq,f[v]
x ∈ { forb, grass, shrub }: Wforb from Fforb; Wgrass and Wshrub from Fmain; own year (t) and plot (g, q) random effects
NegBin( N′ × exp ηf,R[q, t] , rf )
N′ = p × quadrat forb count + (1 − p) × group mean count; ηf,R uses quadrat forb count and grass and shrub cover in place of W
Point records carry no size: survival and recruitment only, without size or trait terms (one pooled population)
Other-shrub submodel (GUSA, ERMI, TECA, PUTR pooled; fitted separately)
α0,s[v] + α1,s[v] × z + γs[v] × E[q, t] + βclimate,s[v] × climate[t] + δsize,s[v] × climate[t] × z
Σx ( βx,s[v] + δx,s[v] × climate[t] ) × Wx[i, t] + εt,s[v] + εg,s[v] + εq,s[v] + εi,s[v]
x ∈ { intra, grass, shrub, forb } (same indices as the main model); one pooled population: no trait, θ, ω or z² (few records)
survival ~ Bernoulli; growth ~ Normal( · , σgrow,s ); recruits ~ NegBin( C′ × exp ηs,R , rs ); recruit size ~ Normal( μrec,s , σrec,s )
Recruits mapped as points (88%) enter the IPM at point size; optional in Part B (held at observed cover when switched off)
